TEXT:
[FI] Looking back on what happened, my relationship 
with Sena might have peaked then.

[FI] In the end, the breast countdown stopped. Since 
then the timer has been stuck at 1.

[FI] In the end, the breast countdown stopped. Since 
then, there wasn't any progress made.
[FI] And right now, I'm...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I never thought we would be joining the same 
company at the same time...

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
[FI] That's what I should be saying. You two knew each 
other from way back, but here I am, the new 
addition.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] You say that, but we were together when we made that 
game, right? If we're talking unexpected, I'm the odd one 
out here. Why am I here with you guys?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Well, call it an undesirable but inseperable 
friendship...
[FI] It had been a few years after that incident.

[FI] It took us another year's attempt, but Akagi and I 
got into the same university.

[FI] Then, by chance, we met Makabe there, somehow it 
led to us making games again... We even ended up 
getting a job at the same game company.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
[FI] I wished the President was here to make the team 
out of the four of us, though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Yeah... I never thought he would still be repeating 
the same year yet again...

[FI] I heard he's known as the Game Research Club's 
Living Buddha now...

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] But hey, it's still awesome that the three of us 
secured a job here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Yeah. Even though I still have no idea what you do 
when it comes to work.

[FI] He's not the creative type. In fact, he's the same as 
ever.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] Yeah well, even in game companies, people are 
tested on their stamina. I'm so handsome. They'll 
surely treasure me!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Normally people don't describe themselves as "I'm 
so handsome".

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [FI] Well I mean, it's true... ahahaha...

[FI] Makabe was the one who made retorts back at the 
Game Research Club, but when he interjects 
nowadays, he works as a buffer.

[FI] The three of us may actually work pretty well 
together.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] Alright! I look forward to working with everyone 
here at Bandai Namco Games!!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Stop making a scene in front of the company, they'll 
think you're weird!

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [FI] I wonder if we'll get along within the company...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] We'll manage somehow, as usual... Well, let's put in 
our best effort.

[FI] As I was replying to Makabe, I was silently getting 
fired up.

[FI] I will... I must accomplish the dream I couldn't at 
the Game Research Club, right in this very 
company.
[FI] Here at Bandai Namco Games...

[FI] I'll make the RPG filled with big-breasted 
glasses-wearing girls that will go down in history!

[FI] While I steeled myself, there was a girl hidden in 
cover watching this scene unfold, someone I wasn't 
yet aware of.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Wow, a school love triangle changing into a 
three-way relationship!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Onii-chan and Kousaka-senpai having Makabe-senpai 
wedged in the middle... I never thought they would 
all enter the same company...!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] W-What should I do... What if Onii-chan and 
Kousaka-senpai ended up making love in the 
company, in their uniforms...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] And Makabe-senpai getting all the affection of the 
entire male staff during the welcome party...!!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] ...It looks so fun... Maybe I'll enter this BanNamu 
company too...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Okay, let's go!

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [FI] Okay.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Uhihihihi...
[FI] Huh? What's with that strange noise just now?
[FI] Probably just my imagination. At any rate...
[FI] Our battle starts now!!

[FI] [font_size=24]"My job can't be at Bandai Namco 
Games"[/font_size] [font_size=30]The End!![/font_size]

[FI] Please look forward to Kousaka Kyousuke-sensei's 
next work!
